resources.string: Solid allows to have your own online storage, which you control. You store information once and decide who can access what.
Allows you to access your Personal Online Data Stores (PODs) on Solid. You can view, upload, edit and shares your files on your Pods.
Register and log in with any Solid Pod provider. We\'ll show you a list to choose from or you can set up your own. It\'s open source!
